description: Validate one XRechnung XML document (UBL or CII) or ZUGFeRD PDF. The file is uploaded to the free keyless API POST https://checkxrechnung.com/v1/validate. Limits: 50 requests per IP per UTC day, 10 per minute, 5 MB. The service reports persisted: false. Provide exactly one of file_path or xml. Returns valid plus errors with rule_id and rule_url.

file_path.description: Path to an XRechnung XML file or a ZUGFeRD PDF. Resolved by this process.

xml.description: XRechnung XML (UBL or CII) as a string. Use this or file_path.

name: validate_xrechnung
title: Validate XRechnung
